name: tank-battle-3d
description: Q版 3D 坦克大战 — mobile chibi tank battle game (Three.js + Capacitor)

scripts.build:playables: tsc --noEmit && vite build --mode playables && node scripts/check-playables-dist.mjs
scripts.android:build: npm run build && cap sync android
scripts.android:debug: npm run build && cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.android:bundle: npm run build && cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease

author: rocketeee
